paragraphs: Avuvram. Ravina said, “Sama bar Chilkai told me: the father of bar Avuvram raised an objection”; some say the brother of bar Avuvram. Rashi explains: a man’s name. The father of bar Avuvram is Avuvram himself. They knew the son but not the father, and called the father after his son, using his son as his identifying sign; chapter Hashochet, 38, end of a. Yuchasin writes in the Arukh’s name that Avuvram is a sage’s name. I did not find it in the Arukh.
